schema_version: v0 — migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: Captured ideas — prose written down at the moment it surfaced, with interpretation deliberately deferred. The artifact of the workflow's FIRST step (press_office/WorkflowDefinition.md, step `capture`).
why: Akien, 2026-08-04: 'capture gets /idea [prose] and it's a one and done. its end state is just when you and I move on to the next thing. the gate is just captured text that I can interpret later.' The lived symptom without it: an idea is spoken, the conversation moves on, and it is gone — no address, no queue, nothing for /intent to reach for. This store is that address. Written by skill:/idea; read by skill:/intent, which cites the idea it came from in its `from_idea` field.
owner: the ideas store owns writes; skills/idea/door.py is the sole writing path (Law 6). A hand-written record here is a record no firing produced and no trace can find.

template.id: string — YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>, derived from the date and the prose
template.author: who had the idea (Akien | CC | …) — load-bearing, not bookkeeping: the spec lives in Akien's head, so an idea authored by him IS the source and an idea authored by CC is a translation of it
template.prose: the idea, in the author's own words, verbatim (required)
template.interpretation: always 'deferred' at capture — the string is here so a reader cannot mistake the absence of analysis for the absence of an idea
template.trace_id: the trace record of the firing that wrote this
template.finding_id: the finding emitted at the firing
template.berth: the berth path of the firing (instance-space; may not exist on another machine)

the_distinction_from_notes.claim: ideas/ and notes/ are near neighbours; the overlap was real until Akien split them on 2026-08-04. RULED: 'slash note becomes more for historical or short term operational notes. could wind up being excised through disuse.'
the_distinction_from_notes.a_note: historical or short-term operational — what was true at a moment, kept because forgetting it would cost something soon. Its use is LOOKUP, and its half-life is short by design.
the_distinction_from_notes.an_idea: a candidate for WORK, still being imagined. Its use is a QUEUE: which ideas have not yet become intentions. One of the three ruled entry points to the system (ruling 2026-08-02, carried in skills/intent/SKILL.md — IDEA, INTENT, TICKET), and step 1 of the workflow with a defined next door.
the_distinction_from_notes.why_not_one_store: the queue question ('what have I not turned into work yet?') cannot be asked of a store that also holds every passing observation. Mixing them costs the queue, not the notes.
the_distinction_from_notes.the_disuse_clause: /note may be excised through disuse rather than by decision — which only works if usage is COUNTED. A skill that is dying and a skill that was never wired look identical in an uncounted system, and excising the second one by mistake would remove a door nobody had tried yet. That is why 'measure each skill's usage, not just efficacy' (Akien, same day) is a precondition for this clause rather than a nice-to-have beside it.

notes_on_the_store: An idea is NOT an intention. It is un-traced, un-challenged, un-cast, and carries no claim that it belongs in the system — /intent's trace question is what decides that, and it is allowed to kill the idea there.
Interpretation is deferred BY DESIGN. Capture that has to be understood before it can be written down is capture with a gate on the wrong side.
Non-terminal: an idea may bear many intentions, one, or none. A dead idea stays here — the record of what was considered and not pursued is worth more than the disk it costs.
